sections.h2: Refined into capsules, a kilo of fish oil is worth many times its crude price

chart.title: The same oil sells for far more in capsules than as crude
chart.sub: Rs per kg of oil. Crude is Peruvian price; capsules are Indian retail, including refining, packing, GST and margin.
chart.source: Commerce and pharmacy prices as reported in the post.

sections.means: Crude fish oil sells for Rs 247-646 a kilogram, while the same oil in 1,000 mg capsules retails for Rs 7,550-13,320.
sections.todo: Landing-centre groups should sell crude oil under contract to licensed refiners, as the post proposes.

sections.h2: A tonne of raw oily fish earns most as refined capsules, not as fishmeal

chart.title: Oil refined into capsules is worth far more per tonne than fishmeal
chart.sub: Rs per tonne of raw oily fish. Capsule value assumes 70% capsule-grade oil at retail prices; illustrative, not accounts.
chart.source: Post's illustrative arithmetic, from by-product and fishmeal yield studies.

sections.means: On the post's illustrative arithmetic, a tonne of oily fish is worth Rs 9,240-23,100 as fishmeal and Rs 369,950-652,680 as capsules.
sections.todo: Landing-centre cooperatives and women's groups should own the low-cost first stage rather than sell juvenile fish to plants.

sections.h2: Karnataka hosts 23 of the 35 fishmeal plants counted in one study

chart.title: Fishmeal plants cluster in Karnataka, which has 23 of the 35 counted
chart.sub: Fishmeal plants by state, from the CIBA study.
chart.source: Central Institute of Brackishwater Aquaculture study.

sections.means: A study counted 35 fishmeal plants, 23 of them in Karnataka, and the post finds no official national figures exist.
sections.todo: Plants should take processing waste rather than whole fish, which the post calls the better raw material for meal and oil.

sections.h2: India sells fish body oil raw and buys back some refined oil

chart.title: Rs 354 crore of fish body oil left India, against Rs 204 crore brought in
chart.sub: Rs crore, 2024-25. Commerce ministry TradeStat figures; ITC-HS codes in brackets.
chart.source: Commerce ministry TradeStat, as tabulated by busy.in.

sections.means: India exported Rs 354 crore of fish body oil in 2024-25 and imported Rs 204 crore of fish lipid, fish body and cod liver oil.
sections.todo: Support should go to shared testing and refining standards that small plants can meet, since a small plant cannot pass FSSAI tests alone.
